evals.prompt: Compare my study notes with the attached article. Flag any claim that overstates the article's findings and cite the relevant passage.
evals.expected_output: A claim-level alignment table with source evidence, status labels, and concise repairs.

evals.prompt: Does this meeting summary accurately reflect the original transcript at ./transcript.txt? I need every omitted qualification called out.
evals.expected_output: A source-bounded review that identifies faithful, qualified, unsupported, and contradicted claims.

evals.prompt: Check these bullet notes against https://example.org/report. Do not fact-check the report itself—only tell me whether the notes match it.
evals.expected_output: A URL-based source comparison, explicitly avoiding external research.
